verdict.rationale: Grok Business documents some admin controls: email invitations of members to the workspace, SSO integration with an IdP, and license-scoped conversation sharing within a team workspace with enterprise privacy protections. Granular permissions/roles and configurable data policies are only implied, not documented. Missing for 10: role/permission management, admin-configurable data retention or usage policies, member removal and deprovisioning details, independent corroboration.
